items.title: Wayne Shorter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The flute player... Herbie Mann... recorded it, and he was in court.

ctx.x: Do you remember the mechanicals, “Notice Of Use” thing... There was something about that. The flute player...

...recorded it, and he was in court. There was a court thing, and it was hinging on the first recording, whoever recorded it at first, and the Notice of Use... They straightened all that stuff out since then. Even if you had a copyright, the Notice of Use thing could be a roadblock. So he had to prove... He won the case, I think.
